NODES.TITLE: Remote profile management
NODES.STATEMENT: The eUICC shall support remote profile management over SMS and HTTPS.

NODES.TITLE: Update profile metadata over SMS
NODES.STATEMENT: The eUICC shall apply an ES6.UpdateMetadata command received over the SMS secure OTA channel within 5 seconds.

NODES.TITLE: Reject unsigned profiles
NODES.STATEMENT: The eUICC shall reject a profile whose signature does not verify.
